Package org.zvec.binding

Class NativeLoader

java.lang.Object
org.zvec.binding.NativeLoader
public final class NativeLoader extends Object
Centralized, three-tier native library loader for the Zvec binding.

The binding depends on two native artifacts: the JavaCPP-generated JNI glue (jnizvec) and the Zvec C-API shared library (zvec_c_api). This loader resolves them with the following precedence, mirroring the JavaCPP runtime model:

  1. Explicit path — when -Dzvec.native.path=/dir (or the ZVEC_NATIVE_PATH environment variable) is set, JavaCPP is steered to resolve zvec_c_api from that directory first (via pathsFirst + platform.preloadpath). Intended for local development and custom native builds.
  2. Classpath / fat JAR — the default JavaCPP behavior extracts the platform-specific libraries bundled under <platform>/ on the classpath (e.g. inside a self-contained fat JAR) to a cache directory and loads them.
  3. System library path — if nothing is bundled, JavaCPP falls back to the operating-system loader search path (java.library.path, LD_LIBRARY_PATH, PATH, ...).

Tier 1 configuration is applied as early as possible from the generated ZvecNative's superclass initializer (presets.ZvecConfig), so it takes effect regardless of which public entry point is touched first. load() simply forces eager loading and converts low-level failures into an actionable UnsatisfiedLinkError.

  • Method Details

    • explicitPath

      public static String explicitPath()
      Resolve the configured explicit native directory, or null when neither "zvec.native.path" nor "ZVEC_NATIVE_PATH" is set. The system property takes precedence over the environment variable.

    • configure

      public static void configure()
      Steer JavaCPP toward the explicit native directory (tier 1) when one is configured. Safe to call repeatedly and a no-op when no explicit path is set, so it may run during JavaCPP code generation without side effects.

      Must run before ZvecNative triggers its own Loader.load(); this is guaranteed by invoking it from the generated class' superclass static initializer.

    • load

      public static void load()
      Eagerly load the Zvec native libraries, applying the three-tier resolution described in the class documentation. Idempotent.
      Throws:
      UnsatisfiedLinkError - if no native library can be resolved

    • isLoaded

      public static boolean isLoaded()
      Returns true once the native libraries have been loaded.
